full_prompt_en: The image is a square monochrome cartoon drawing on a warm cream paper ground. A tall, thin man with angular hair and heavy square glasses stands near the center holding an open book or stack of pages. His downturned mouth and narrowed eyes give him a weary, impatient expression. He wears a dark jacket over a shirt and tie, and his hands support the pages near his waist. The foreground is partly interrupted by small comical figures, including a tiny round-headed character near the bottom center and a dark-eared animal at the lower right. Behind the main man, many caricatured faces, arms, hats, and animal shapes crowd together in a bustling street. A rabbit-eared figure peeks out from the left background. Sketched building fronts rise above the crowd, their roofs and windows receding toward the center. The crowd is densely detailed but lighter in tone than the man's jacket, so he remains immediately readable. Pen and pencil-like marks vary from thick black contours to fine crosshatching. Short strokes describe wrinkles, fabric folds, hair, and the busy backdrop. White paper remains visible between marks, especially around the outer margin. Grayscale washes or softer gray pencil areas give slight volume without creating a colored scene. There is no single dramatic light source; contrast is distributed through line weight and tonal density. The composition is crowded behind the main figure, with a quiet blank border around the drawing. Humor comes from the sober central reader surrounded by a chaotic swarm of exaggerated characters. Its tactile surface and rapid yet precise linework preserve the feel of an original printed cartoon sketch.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形单色漫画素描，画在暖奶油色纸面上。一名高瘦男子有棱角发型和厚方框眼镜，站在中央附近，手中拿着打开的书或一叠纸。下垂的嘴和收紧的眼睛使他显得疲惫而不耐烦。他穿深外套、衬衫和领带，双手在腰间托住纸页。前景有几个小滑稽人影局部打断，包括底部中央的小圆头人物和右下一只深耳动物。主角身后，许多漫画化的脸、手臂、帽子和动物形挤在繁忙街道中。一只兔耳形从左侧背景探出。速写楼面从人群上方升起，屋顶和窗向中央后退。人群细节密集，但调子比男子外套浅，使他立刻可读。钢笔和铅笔般笔痕从厚黑轮廓到细交叉排线都有。短线描绘皱纹、衣褶、头发和忙乱背景。白纸在笔痕之间可见，尤其在外边留白处。灰阶色洗或较柔的灰色铅笔区域给予少量体积，却没有变成彩色场景。画中没有单一戏剧光源；对比由线条重量和调子密度分配。构图在主角身后拥挤，图外保留安静空边。幽默来自一本正经的中央读者被一群夸张角色包围。可触的表面与快速却准确的线工保留原始印刷漫画草图的感觉。
style_prompt_en: Monochrome comic drawing uses variable ink contours, lively caricature, fine crosshatching, and warm paper left visible between marks. A darker central silhouette can stand out against a densely populated but paler field of small faces and objects. Buildings and background details remain sketchy, while focal expression and hands are more decisively outlined. Gray washes or pencil tones add limited volume without replacing the linework. Empty margins let the dense center breathe. The rhythm is humorous and restless, carried by changing scale, overlapping gestures, and sharp little observational details. The finish feels printed or hand drawn rather than digitally smooth.
style_prompt_zh: 单色漫画素描运用粗细变化的墨轮廓、活泼夸张的人物、细交叉排线和笔痕间露出的暖纸面。较深的中央剪影可从密集却较浅的小脸与物体中站出。建筑和背景细节保持速写感，焦点表情与手则勾得更果断。灰色水洗或铅笔调子增加有限体积，却不取代线工。外边空处让密集中心得以呼吸。节奏幽默且躁动，由变化尺度、重叠手势和尖锐的小观察细节承载。成品像印刷或手绘，而非数字平滑。
theme_en: A frowning bespectacled man reading amid a crowded cartoon street
theme_zh: 一名皱眉戴眼镜的男子在人群拥挤的漫画街道中读书
name: Al Jaffee
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
